items.title: Seahawks Turn to Drew Lock with Darnold Out for Week 2 at Arizona
items.one_line: Sam Darnold is out 3–4 weeks with a soft-tissue glute injury; Drew Lock starts Sunday at State Farm Stadium after 187 yards and a TD in relief of the Week 1 win over New England.

items.title: Seahawks Rock Navy Jerseys and Grey Pants for Cardinals Clash
items.one_line: 1-0 Seattle visits 1-0 Arizona with Lock starting; lines favor Seattle by ~3.5–4.5 while ESPN Analytics gives the home Cardinals a 53.7% win chance.

items.title: Falcons Stick with Rush at QB as Penix Nears Return, Tua Sidelined
items.one_line: Cooper Rush is expected to start Week 2 vs. Carolina; Tua sits with an oblique while Michael Penix Jr. splits first-team reps in his measured ACL return.

items.title: Falcons QB Chaos Looms Before Panthers Game
items.one_line: Stefanski has yet to lock a starter among Penix, Tagovailoa (oblique), Rush (back), and undrafted Jack Strand; fans venting ahead of the Mercedes-Benz home opener.

items.title: Ravens and Saints Release Week 2 Injury Reports with Key Starters Sidelined
items.one_line: Zay Flowers listed out (hamstring); Stanley (toe), Simpson (groin), Hendrickson (finger), and T.J. Tampa (knee) also missed Thursday; Saints list Olave/Young limited and LS Zach Wood out.

items.title: Ravens Work Out Veteran WR Brandin Cooks Amid Injuries
items.one_line: Baltimore brought in 32-year-old Brandin Cooks after Flowers’ hamstring and Ja’Kobi Lane’s IR wrist surgery; no signing yet as Week 2 nears.

items.title: Ravens OC Doyle: No Smiles Until the Clock Hits Zero
items.one_line: First-year play-caller Declan Doyle explained his stone-faced booth style after Flowers’ 54-yard TD; focus on sustained execution after the 41-23 Colts rout.

items.title: Bills Edge Lions 48-42 in High-Scoring Thursday Thriller

items.title: Bills Christen New Highmark Stadium with Lions in Primetime Win
items.one_line: Josh Allen scored the inaugural TD at the $2.1B Highmark Stadium; DT Ed Oliver sat with a hip injury from warm-ups amid fireworks and dual anthems.

items.title: Bills Fans Protest O.J. Simpson's Exclusion from New Stadium Honor Wall

items.title: Panthers Name Metchie III Primary Punt and Kick Returner for Falcons Game
items.one_line: John Metchie III takes over returns after Jimmy Horn Jr. was waived and Trevor Etienne hit IR; Canales still wants him as a receiver first with Coker dinged.

items.title: Panthers DC Evero Stresses Accountability After Record 59-Point Loss
items.one_line: Ejiro Evero owned the scheme/conditioning meltdown that allowed Chicago 552 yards and six rushing TDs in the 59-37 home loss.

items.one_line: Sixth-rounder Horn was waived a day after muffing a punt in Week 1; LB Tyrel Dodson promoted; Canales left the practice-squad door open.

items.one_line: Williams earned FedEx Air & Ground (269 pass / 65 rush, 4 total TDs); Swift added 124 and three scores as Chicago set a Week 1 scoring mark.

items.title: Joe Burrow Expects to Play Through Back Tightness vs. Texans

items.title: Texans GM Caserio Calls Bengals Offensive Line 'Myth' Narrative a Myth
items.one_line: Nick Caserio praised Cincinnati’s tackles/center chemistry and Burrow’s role ahead of Sunday’s NRG matchup.

items.title: Jimmy Horn Jr. Joins Browns Practice Squad to Reunite with Shedeur Sanders
items.one_line: Waived by Carolina after a muffed punt, Horn cleared to Cleveland’s PS and reunites with Colorado teammate Shedeur Sanders.

items.one_line: After 205 yards / 1 TD / 1 INT and five sacks in a 34-10 loss to JAX, Watson cited 400-yard expectations; Stephen A. and Cowherd piled on.

items.one_line: Jason La Canfora sources say Jimmy Haslam wants Arch Manning in the 2029 Brook Park dome amid Watson unrest; unconfirmed.
